QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C and the PTHREAD/ALT macros off (commented out), so a default build defines none of the threading macros.
